# Luxova Home
> Custom and ready-to-assemble cabinetry — kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, closets and wardrobes. Made in the USA, shipped flat from 6 warehouses nationwide. Free 3D design and quote. Certified TSCA Title VI, KCMA, CARB2, NGBS Green.

## Product Lines
- [Kitchen Cabinets](https://luxovahome.com/c/kitchen-cabinets/): Shaker, Slim Shaker, and handleless kitchen cabinetry. Made in the USA. RTA (ready-to-assemble), customizable layouts. Starting from $99.99 per linear foot.
- [Bathroom Vanities](https://luxovahome.com/c/bathroom-vanities/): Single and double vanities with soft-close drawers and moisture-tolerant finishes, sized to your bathroom. From $119.99 per linear foot.
- [Closets & Wardrobes](https://luxovahome.com/c/closets-wardrobes/): Walk-in and reach-in closets with shelving, drawers and rails. From $149.99 per linear foot.
- [Cabinet Door Styles & Finishes](https://luxovahome.com/door-styles/): Six door collections (Shaker, Slim Shaker, Double Shaker, Iris, Vienna, Cottage) in painted and stained finishes. Free door samples available.
- [Interior Doors](https://luxovahome.com/interior-doors/): PET room doors made to match cabinet finishes.
- [Accessories](https://luxovahome.com/accessories/): Drawer boxes, drawer slides, handles, hinges, LED lighting, organizers, trim panels — sold separately, stocked in U.S. warehouses.

## Key Facts
- Construction: 1/2" cabinet-grade plywood box, UV-coated interior, no particleboard. Full-overlay doors. Dovetailed drawer boxes. Soft-close hinges and undermount glides throughout.
- Certifications: TSCA Title VI, KCMA, CARB2, NGBS Green.
- Fulfillment: 6 U.S. warehouses — Houston TX (base), Phoenix AZ, Chicago IL, Ohio, North Carolina, Florida. Ships flat (RTA).
- Design service: free 3D design and non-binding quote. Free door samples.
- Pricing model: quoted per project; "from" prices are per linear foot of cabinetry. A typical 10x10 kitchen is about 25 linear feet, so kitchens start around $2,500 in cabinets.
- Contact: info@luxovahome.com

## Planning Reference (standard sizes)
- Base cabinets: 34 1/2" high, 24" deep. Wall cabinets: 12" deep, 30/36/42" high.
- Countertop: 1 1/2" thick, 25 1/2" deep. Counter-to-wall-cabinet clearance: 18".
- Appliance allowances: refrigerator 36"w x 72"h, dishwasher 24"w, range 30"w.

## About
Luxova Home (Luxlive Home LLC) is a Houston, Texas-based cabinetry brand backed by 18+ years of custom-cabinetry manufacturing expertise. Serving homeowners, builders, contractors and developers nationwide. Trade membership for contractors: https://luxovahome.com/member/
